libraryRootNoteId.label: Library Root
libraryRootNoteId.description: Required. The note that hosts your library: its Database child note holds every tracked game. Selecting it converts that note into a render note showing the tracker; clearing it reverts the previously-chosen note to a text note.

collectionGroups.label: Collection Groups
collectionGroups.description: JSON holding the collection groups and which group each collection belongs to. Managed by the Collections tab.

viewGroupFilters.label: Last Group Filters
viewGroupFilters.description: Remembered per-group Library filters. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

genresEnabled.label: Enable Genres
genresEnabled.description: Show the Genre filter and fetch genres from IGDB. Turn this off to categorise everything with your own collections instead.

hiddenGenres.label: Hidden Genres
hiddenGenres.description: Comma-separated genres to leave out of the Library's genre filter. Managed by the Genres tab.

viewGenreFilter.label: Last Genre Filter
viewGenreFilter.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewStatusFilter.label: Last Status Filter
viewStatusFilter.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewPlatformFilter.label: Last Platform Filter
viewPlatformFilter.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewCollectionFilter.label: Last Collection Filter
viewCollectionFilter.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewSortKey.label: Last Sort
viewSortKey.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewSortDesc.label: Last Sort Direction
viewSortDesc.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewGrouped.label: Last Grouping
viewGrouped.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

statuses.label: Statuses
statuses.description: The statuses a game can have. Add, rename, recolour, reorder, or remove them freely. Each status carries a Role, which is how imports know what a status means without depending on its name: an import targets the role, so renaming Beaten to Finished (or adding your own Wishlist alongside Backlog) never breaks it. Removing a status leaves any game still holding it untouched — the tracker shows it as-is until you change it.

name.label: Name
name.description: Shown in the status dropdown and filters.

role.label: Role
role.description: What this status means to imports and automation. Several statuses may share a role, and 'None' means imports never set this status automatically — pick that for statuses you only ever apply by hand.

color.label: Colour
color.description: Used for this status throughout the tracker.

defaultStatusId.label: Status For New Games
defaultStatusId.description: Which status a game added by hand gets. Chosen on the Statuses tab; falls back to the first backlog-role status when unset.

coverSize.label: Cover Size
coverSize.description: IGDB image size used for cover URLs stored with each game. Has no effect on RAWG, which serves a single image URL per game.

sources.label: Metadata Sources
sources.description: Where covers, genres, platforms, and summaries come from. Sources are consulted in the order listed and merged FIELD BY FIELD: the first source that supplies a value wins that field, and any it leaves empty falls through to the next. So a game can end up with IGDB's platforms, SteamGridDB's cover, and Steam's summary. Reorder to change precedence; untick to disable. Three sources need no key at all (Steam, GOG, Lutris), so the tracker works with no setup whatsoever.

name.label: Source
name.description: Display name only. The source itself is identified by its entry id, so renaming this changes nothing but the label.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Untick to skip this source entirely. A source needing a key you have not set is skipped automatically, so leaving it on is harmless.

rawgApiKey.label: RAWG API Key
rawgApiKey.description: Free key from https://rawg.io/apidocs — a plain email signup, no OAuth and no two-factor requirement. The free tier allows 20,000 requests per month.

steamGridDbApiKey.label: SteamGridDB API Key
steamGridDbApiKey.description: Free key from https://www.steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api (a plain signup). SteamGridDB supplies cover art only — no genres, summaries, or platforms — so it is worth enabling only if you want better artwork than the general sources provide.

gamesDbApiKey.label: TheGamesDB API Key
gamesDbApiKey.description: Free key from https://thegamesdb.net (log in, then API Key). Best coverage of retro and console titles. Note it has a monthly request quota, which is why it ships last in the order and disabled — placed last, it is only consulted for fields the other sources left empty.

gamesDbLookups.label: TheGamesDB Lookup Tables
gamesDbLookups.description: Cached genre/developer/platform id-to-name tables from TheGamesDB, fetched once so resolving those fields costs no extra quota per game. Managed automatically; clear it to refetch.

igdbClientId.label: IGDB (Twitch) Client ID
igdbClientId.description: IGDB authenticates through Twitch. Register an application at https://dev.twitch.tv/console/apps with Client Type set to Confidential, then copy its Client ID here. Twitch requires two-factor authentication on the account before it will allow app registration; if you cannot enable it, switch Metadata Provider to RAWG instead.

igdbClientSecret.label: IGDB (Twitch) Client Secret
igdbClientSecret.description: Client Secret from the same Twitch application. Used to obtain an access token; IGDB is free for non-commercial use.

igdbAccessToken.label: Access Token
igdbAccessToken.description: Fetched automatically from the Client ID and Secret, and renewed before it expires. Managed automatically.

steamApiKey.label: Steam Web API Key
steamApiKey.description: Free key from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. Required to import your Steam library.

steamId.label: SteamID64
steamId.description: Your 17-digit Steam id. Use the Steam ID tab to convert a profile name or URL into one.

steamOnlyPlayed.label: Import Only Played Games
steamOnlyPlayed.description: Skip owned games with no recorded playtime. Useful when a large bundle library would otherwise flood the tracker.

autoSyncSteam.label: Auto-Import From Steam
autoSyncSteam.description: Run a Steam import automatically on a schedule. Requires a Steam key and SteamID64.

autoSyncHours.label: Hours Between Auto-Imports
autoSyncHours.description: Minimum hours to wait between automatic imports. The check runs hourly, so 1 imports every hour and 24 once a day.

autoSyncLastRun.label: Last Auto-Import
autoSyncLastRun.description: Timestamp of the last automatic import. Managed automatically.

autoSyncLastResult.label: Last Auto-Import Result
autoSyncLastResult.description: Outcome of the last automatic import, shown on the Import tab. Managed automatically.

importMarksPlaying.label: Imports Set Playing Status
importMarksPlaying.description: A game with recorded playtime is moved out of the backlog into Playing. Nothing is ever marked Beaten by an import: playtime cannot tell whether a game was finished.

importFetchMetadata.label: Fetch IGDB Metadata On Import
importFetchMetadata.description: Look each imported Steam game up on IGDB for its cover, summary, genres, and platforms. Slower, and needs IGDB credentials.

importOverwriteRatings.label: Let Imports Overwrite My Ratings
importOverwriteRatings.description: Off by default so a re-import never clobbers a rating you set in Trilium. Import is one-way; nothing is ever written back to Steam or IGDB.
